name: JumpServer 堡垒机
description: Connect to a JumpServer bastion host and run permission-gated, audited commands on your internal assets.
description_zh: 连接 JumpServer 堡垒机，在权限管控与全量审计的前提下对内网资产执行运维命令、采集拓扑与执行 Runbook。
description_en: Connect to a JumpServer bastion host and run permission-gated, audited operations on internal assets.
examples_zh: 连接堡垒机，列出我有权限访问的资产
看看 oa-app-01 上的磁盘和内存使用情况
对 OA 组的所有服务器执行一次健康巡检 Runbook
把刚才的审计记录导出成 CSV
examples_en: Connect to the bastion and list the assets I can access
Check disk and memory usage on oa-app-01
Run the health-check runbook against the OA asset group
Export the recent audit records as CSV
